content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account access today?
Hi, I need to reset my password for the company portal.
Absolutely, I can help with that. Please start by going to the company portal homepage and clicking on the 'Forgot Password' link below the login fields.
Okay, I see the link and clicked it. It’s asking for my username and work email.
Great. Please enter your assigned username and your company email address, then press 'Submit'.
Done. It says a verification code was sent to my email.
Perfect. Check your inbox for an email from 'IT Support'—the code should be six digits. Enter that code in the field provided on the portal.
I received the code and entered it. Now it’s asking me to set a new password.
Go ahead and create a new password. Remember to use at least eight characters, including a number and a symbol, for security. After entering your new password, click 'Save'.
All set! I can log in now. Thanks for your help.
